_comment: Printed wall lines on tile edges, one entry per face, in the tile's
unrotated frame. Generated by tools/wall_detect.py --write from the
art; 'unsure' lists edges the detector could not settle and
tools/wall_review.json overrides it. Do not edit by hand.

Core_16B.why: Dark floor along the south row gives a black line no luminance contrast, and the tile label sits in this square, so the detector read half coverage. Kept as wall. Only OTHER30 butts another tile here (Core_36B's east end); if the printed tile shows an opening, correct it at the table.

Core_36B.why: Same join as Core_16B (1,1)S in OTHER30: dark floor, tile label in the square, half coverage. The A side of this cardboard has a confident wall on the same end. Kept as wall.
